body:
CROSS-CRITIQUE CONVERGENCE:
- Delivery/product/logic agree the secure production axis is DEVICE TRUST, not Extend vs Duplicate: public Stage PC/profile + already-authenticated private controller device works in both. Phone authenticates before projector; Stage shows short-lived non-authorizing display code; phone approves binding; server issues Stage AudienceDisplaySession only and atomically increments displayBindingEpoch. Co-resident Console is later convenience because Win+P Extend->Duplicate may expose a private frame before reactive curtains.
- Kill the clever one-click neutral/private launcher fork. Default separate-site Stage popup/manual placement + Stage-local fullscreen click. Auto-placement earns itself later.
- Scope critic conceded single-origin import graph/canary is only prototype hygiene, not production security evidence. Separate-site boundary test must simulate compromised Stage runtime attacking cookies/storage/SW/private APIs/private WSS/topics; require structural reachability denial plus bounded differential traces. Narrow public DTO/gateway is mandatory.
- A venue-independent BroadcastChannel extended demo is permissible only as a disposable curated-data FEASIBILITY prototype with explicit no-claim language; it is not the product MVP or proof of two-mode architecture. If venue is mirrored, relay/auth is P0. Relay/phone may be a stretch demo only after core readiness passes; never reverse priority.
- Logic resolved authority: field-specific. Stage/viewer owns observed rendered `(deckVersion, slideId, slideSeq)`; session coordinator owns controller lease/command outcome; publish service owns cards/tombstones. Use independent gap-free role streams (`controlRevision`, `publicPlaybackRevision`, `publicCardRevision`), never expose global log gaps.
- During WSS loss, cached Stage may navigate locally and cards freeze. Reconnect reports absolute hash-pinned state; server accepts only if binding/epoch valid, else human reconcile. No relative replay. Takeover/pairing/lease+epoch+old-session revocation require linearizable CAS/transaction.
- Staffing fork from delivery: guarded pilot 13-16 weeks with 5 core FTE + part-time privacy/ops; 3 generalists 20-26 weeks or explicitly cut live-public AI and auto-placement.
summary: Peer debate convergence and corrected MVP axis
